_note: Known limits shown by the API (/api/limits) and docs. PM-only AQI estimates are internal data checks and are never shown as AQI.

limits.title: Delhi Diwali 2025: our PM-only check does not match official AQI
limits.detail: For the 2025-10-21 bulletin, our internal PM-only AQI estimate is 481 while CPCB's official AQI is 351. The source's 999 µg/m³ limit explains about 60 points; the 4 PM window and our data gaps do not explain the rest. The remaining gap is unexplained (likely CPCB's own feed or validation). The app shows official AQI for Diwali and never shows PM-only estimates.

limits.title: Network-wide data gaps
limits.detail: About 30% of city-days have network-wide gaps in the OpenAQ archive; severe days are labelled and excluded from weather associations.

limits.title: Missing midnight readings (older data)
limits.detail: OpenAQ archive files before about 2026-08-17 lack readings ending 00:00-00:30 IST. In November 2026 hours 23:00 and 00:00 IST often have only 2 of 4 readings (archive and API alike), so they are not valid hours.

limits.title: Delhi PM above 999 µg/m³ is blank in OpenCity
limits.detail: Delhi Diwali 2024 and 2025 PM is supporting context only, shown as lower bounds; no PM percentage changes. Diwali 2026 Delhi PM comes from OpenAQ (no 999 limit) and is never compared with them.

limits.title: Diwali PM incomplete outside Delhi
limits.detail: Measured PM for Diwali 2025 is incomplete in Mumbai, Kolkata, Chennai, Bengaluru and Hyderabad; Diwali answers use official AQI.

limits.title: Station sets differ from CPCB
limits.detail: Bengaluru and Chennai use fewer stations than CPCB's bulletins, so their measured values match official AQI less closely.

limits.title: Single-station outliers
limits.detail: Peer-outlier stations are flagged, not removed; a warning is shown when one moves a city value by more than 25% (92 city-days).

limits.title: Fault flags are rules of thumb
limits.detail: Flat-line, spike and PM2.5 > PM10 checks are heuristics; supported events (Diwali nights, corroborated plumes) are kept.

limits.title: Data end dates
limits.detail: Measured PM ends 2026-11-11 (OpenAQ archive to 2026-11-08, then the OpenAQ API for 9-11 Nov); official AQI bulletins end 2026-11-11; weather ends 2026-11-11. Refreshed 2026-11-12.

limits.title: Weather is modelled
limits.detail: Open-Meteo reanalysis for one grid cell per city, from 2025-02-18 (none for Diwali 2024). Free tier is non-commercial. Results are associations, not causes.

limits.title: Number check covers numbers, not meaning
limits.detail: Every number in an answer must come from a tool result, and cards are built by code, but the wording around numbers is not semantically verified.

limits.title: Free-tier AI limits
limits.detail: Live answers depend on Gemini free tiers (Groq is configured but disabled); when they are exhausted the app serves cached answers and data pages only.

limits.title: Shared AI quota counters reset when the server restarts
limits.detail: The per-model counters (requests and tokens per minute and per day) live in the API process. A Render restart or a second instance starts from zero, and local scripts (evaluation, terminal) are counted separately. The 80% safety margin and the providers' own 429 handling are the backstop: a real daily 429 blocks that model until its reset. Google enforces its per-minute limit loosely: 20 sequential requests in 51 s were accepted before a parallel burst got 429s.

limits.title: Token counts before a request are estimates
limits.detail: Before each request the limiter estimates its tokens from the message size (measured at about 1.3x the real count on 2026-11-06), then records the provider's real usage. Hidden SDK retries after a 429 or 5xx are not counted.

limits.title: Visitor identification on Render is checked by simulation only
limits.detail: Rate limits use the client IP from True-Client-IP, then CF-Connecting-IP (set by Cloudflare in front of Render), never X-Forwarded-For or X-Visitor-Id, which clients can fake. Render does not document these headers officially; confirm after deploying with GET /api/visitor (it should say identified_by: true-client-ip). Visitors behind one shared IP (office, campus) share one limit.

limits.title: Recent official AQI read from CPCB's own PDFs
limits.detail: UrbanEmissions' bulletin dataset ends 2026-10-25. Bulletins from 2026-10-26 (including Diwali 2026) are read from CPCB's daily bulletin PDFs (cpcb.gov.in). The reader matched UrbanEmissions exactly on 1,501 city-days of overlapping bulletins (AQI, category, stations, prominent pollutant). Each value records its source.

limits.title: Latest measured days come from the OpenAQ API
limits.detail: 9-11 Nov 2026 were not yet in the OpenAQ archive, so they come from the OpenAQ API (same raw 15-minute readings; identical to the archive on a test day). They are provisional and are replaced by archive files on the next refresh.

limits.title: OpenAQ gap on Diwali night 2026 (Delhi)
limits.detail: On the night of 8-9 Nov 2026 fewer than half of Delhi's 37 stations reported from about 23:00 to 02:00 IST (as few as 13). Diwali 2025 had a one-hour network-wide gap at 21:00. Measured Diwali-night PM is therefore incomplete; official AQI is the main Diwali result.

limits.title: OpenAQ outage 25-27 Oct 2026
limits.detail: OpenAQ has no readings for any city on 25-26 Oct 2026 and a partial gap on 27 Oct. These days are the Diwali 2026 baseline (D-14..D-8), so no Delhi station meets the measured-PM baseline rule and no Diwali 2026 PM baseline is given.
